description_expanded: Overview5.0(16 reviews)DUNE ALLEN BEACH – Sea Vous Play Coastal Retreat with Golf Cart & Bikes | Pet Friendly | Sleeps 11 DESCRIPTION Welcome to Sea Vous Play, a charming coastal retreat nestled in Dune Allen Beach. This spacious 4-bedroom home, plus a bunk room, offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience, and beach access. Just a short 3-minute golf cart ride to a stunning white-sand beach, Sea Vous Play is pet-friendly and designed to make your stay as relaxing as possible. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Take a quick golf cart ride to the expansive beach, or enjoy the serene wooded views from the outdoor dining area and private screened porch. The community pool and clubhouse are just steps away for more relaxation and enjoyment. HOME FEATURES 4 bedrooms + bunk room | 3 full + 1 half bathrooms | Sleeps 11 Two master suites, one on the first floor for easy accessibility Gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops Cozy bunk room opening to a private screened porch, perfect for kids Pack 'n play & high chair available for families with young children Pet friendly (additional pet fee applies) DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Indoor dining area and outdoor dining on the patio Easy access to shopping, dining, and entertainment on 30A Close proximity to community pool and clubhouse WHY STAY HERE? Perfect for families and pet lovers, with ample space and a welcoming atmosphere Quick beach access with included golf cart and four bikes Ideal for multiple families with two master suites and a fun bunk room for kids SLEEPING ACCOMMODATIONS 3 King bedrooms 1 Queen bedroom + Bunk room with Twin bunk over trundle Book your stay at Sea Vous Play for a memorable coastal escape on 30A!Show less
